verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official SDK with sync and async clients for application code (cekura-docs-5) and uses it to instrument LiveKit agents for tracing (cekura-docs-15, cekura-docs-40). The evidence never states which language that SDK targets, and nothing shows an official JS/TS SDK; the npx command only installs AI-assistant skills, not an instrumentation SDK. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a Python SDK, an officially supported JS/TS instrumentation SDK, general-purpose (non-LiveKit) tracing instrumentation docs, independent corroboration
